name: hack-squat-machine-narrow-stance
title: Hack Squat: Machine (Narrow Stance)
primer: Like the Hack Squat, this exercise works the muscles of the leg.
steps: Lie face up on a Hack Squat machine with your shoulders against the pad.
Place your feet facing forward at a distance of 6 inches apart with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Release the dock levers and place your hands on the handgrips.
Drawing your abs in, extend your body standing upright.
Lower your body to a squatting position so your knees are bent as if you were sitting down.
tips: The narrow stance targets the external muscles more efficiently.
